People · Passion · Exceptional Food

The story behind

Good food brings people together. At RARA Kitchen Studio, we combine culinary expertise, creative presentation and genuine hospitality to create memorable experiences for every occasion.

01 / 04

From passion
to

RARA Kitchen Studio was created in 2021 with a simple belief — exceptional food should bring people together and make every occasion feel special.

Based in Delhi NCR, we bring together culinary creativity, thoughtful presentation and warm hospitality across weddings, private celebrations, corporate gatherings and special events.

Beyond the Kitchen

Embassies, global events & Raman

RARA Kitchen Studio brings Indian culinary expertise to distinguished gatherings, international showcases, diplomatic occasions and high-profile events. Chef Raman Kohli is closely involved in these experiences, representing RARA with the same warmth, creativity and attention to detail that define our catering.

Culinary hospitality with an international outlook.
The People Behind

Our team

Behind every RARA experience is a dedicated team of culinary and hospitality professionals. From live service and presentation to guest care and coordination, our people bring the same attention to detail that defines every event we deliver.

A professional team, working together to make every occasion feel effortless.
